//===== Ragnarok Offline: path-of-ragnarok ====================================
//= GENERATED by tools/build-tree.js from tools/passive_tree.template.txt.
//= Edit the template or the tables in the generator, never this file.
//=
//= What it does
//=   - Each character gets passive points from its job level (settings below).
//=   - A tree node is allocated by id; the id list is kept in the permanent
//=     character array PT_nodes[]. PT_start is the free starting node.
//=   - The bonuses are applied by ONE permanent bonus_script that calls
//=     F_PT_Bonus on every stat recalculation. F_PT_Bonus reads PT_nodes[]
//=     and runs the bonus line of each node, so nothing has to be cleared
//=     (bonus_script_clear can only wipe every script of the player).
//=   - Skill points (setting skill_points, 5 by default): the character collects them once (PT_spc, 0 = not yet
//=     collected) and spends them on the ETC tab of the window to learn any skill of any class, one point per level.
//=     What was learned is kept in PT_ls[] (skill id), PT_ll[] (level) and PT_sps (points spent); L_Skills gives it
//=     with skill <id>,<lv>,3 (permanent, survives job changes). The list of skills a server knows is
//=     passive_tree_skills.txt ($@PT_skok[id] = max level). PT_gs[] only remains to take back the skills that older
//=     versions of the tree taught from nodes.
//=   - The client window (client/index.js) talks to this script through
//=       @passive <n> state | cards | alloc <id,id,...> | refund <id> | reset
//=               | socket <node> <card id> | unsocket <node> | choose <node> <option>
//=               | sclaim | slearn <skill id> <level>
//=     and gets one line back:
//=       status|message|start|points|mult|refund|ids|sockets|inventory cards|cards on|socket price|choices|job line|keystone limit|reborn|drop cap|builds|current slot|swap price|skill points setting|collected|spent|renewal|learned
//=     (refund is -1 when refunds are switched off; sockets is node:card,...;
//=     the inventory list, id:amount,..., only comes with the "cards" request).
//=     Typing @passive on its own opens the window.
//=   - Card sockets: the card is taken from the inventory and its id kept in
//=     PT_sc[] next to the socket node id in PT_sn[]. F_PT_Bonus runs
//=     F_PT_Card (passive_tree_cards.txt, generated per era) for each one.
//=   - Builds: up to 5 saved trees per character (commands bsave, bload, bdel, bname); see L_BuildSave / L_BuildLoad.
//=   - Masteries: the chosen option of a mastery node is kept in PT_mn[] (node) and
//=     PT_mv[] (option 1..4); F_PT_Bonus runs the entry node*10+option for it.
//=   - Job-line nodes (.req) only allocate for that second-class line, and some
//=     nodes (.rs) need a skill level; both are checked in L_Alloc.
//===========================================================================

-	script	PassiveTree	-1,{
	end;

OnPCLoginEvent:
	freeloop(1);
	callsub L_Sync;
	end;

OnPCJobLvUpEvent:
	freeloop(1);
	.@before = PT_earned;
	callsub L_Sync;
	if (PT_start && PT_earned > .@before && min(PT_earned, .max) > getarraysize(PT_nodes))
		dispbottom "[Passive Tree] You gained a passive point. Press Alt+P or type @passive.";
	end;

// ---- the window's requests ------------------------------------------------
OnQuery:
	// every loop iteration counts towards the script's "infinite loop" limit (2048 jumps); a long
	// alloc path blew through it and the reply never came. Loops here are all bounded.
	freeloop(1);
	if (.@atcmd_numparameters < 1) {
		dispbottom "@@event passive open";
		end;
	}
	callsub L_Sync;
	debugmes "[path-of-ragnarok] " + strcharinfo(0) + ": " + .@atcmd_parameters$[1] + " " + .@atcmd_parameters$[2] + " (start " + PT_start + ", points " + min(PT_earned, .max) + ", used " + getarraysize(PT_nodes) + ")";
	.@cmd$ = .@atcmd_parameters$[1];
	.@arg$ = .@atcmd_parameters$[2];
	.@status$ = "ok";
	.@msg$ = "";
	if (!PT_start) {
		.@status$ = "err";
		.@msg$ = "Choose a first class to wake the passive tree.";
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "alloc") {
		deletearray .@ids$[0], getarraysize(.@ids$);
		explode(.@ids$, .@arg$, ",");
		.@c = getarraysize(.@ids$);
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@c; .@i++) {
			.@r$ = callsub(L_Alloc, atoi(.@ids$[.@i]));
			if (.@r$ != "") {
				.@status$ = "err";
				.@msg$ = .@r$;
				break;
			}
		}
		callsub L_Apply;
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "refund") {
		.@r$ = callsub(L_Refund, atoi(.@arg$));
		if (.@r$ != "") {
			.@status$ = "err";
			.@msg$ = .@r$;
		}
		callsub L_Apply;
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "reset") {
		.@r$ = callsub(L_Reset);
		if (.@r$ != "") {
			.@status$ = "err";
			.@msg$ = .@r$;
		}
		callsub L_Apply;
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "socket") {
		.@r$ = callsub(L_Socket, atoi(.@arg$), atoi(.@atcmd_parameters$[3]));
		if (.@r$ != "") {
			.@status$ = "err";
			.@msg$ = .@r$;
		}
		callsub L_Apply;
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "unsocket") {
		.@r$ = callsub(L_Unsocket, atoi(.@arg$));
		if (.@r$ != "") {
			.@status$ = "err";
			.@msg$ = .@r$;
		}
		callsub L_Apply;
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "bsave") {
		.@slot = atoi(.@arg$);
		.@bn$ = callsub(L_BuildName, .@atcmd_parameters$[3]);
		if (.@slot < 1 || .@slot > .builds) {
			.@status$ = "err";
			.@msg$ = "Unknown slot.";
		} else {
			if (.@bn$ == "")
				.@bn$ = "Build_" + .@slot;
			callsub L_BuildSave, .@slot, .@bn$;
			.@msg$ = "Saved the tree in slot " + .@slot + ".";
		}
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "bload") {
		.@msg$ = callsub(L_BuildLoad, atoi(.@arg$));
		if (!@pt_bok)
			.@status$ = "err";
		callsub L_Apply;
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "bdel") {
		.@slot = atoi(.@arg$);
		if (.@slot < 1 || .@slot > .builds) {
			.@status$ = "err";
			.@msg$ = "Unknown slot.";
		} else {
			callsub L_BuildClear, .@slot;
			.@msg$ = "Slot " + .@slot + " emptied.";
		}
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "bname") {
		.@slot = atoi(.@arg$);
		.@bn$ = callsub(L_BuildName, .@atcmd_parameters$[3]);
		if (.@slot < 1 || .@slot > .builds || !getd("PT_b" + .@slot + "_used") || .@bn$ == "") {
			.@status$ = "err";
			.@msg$ = "Cannot rename that slot (empty, or the name has no usable characters).";
		} else {
			setd("PT_b" + .@slot + "_name$", .@bn$);
		}
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "sclaim") {
		.@r$ = callsub(L_SkillClaim);
		if (.@r$ != "") {
			.@status$ = "err";
			.@msg$ = .@r$;
		} else
			.@msg$ = "You collected " + PT_spc + " skill points.";
		callsub L_Apply;
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "slearn") {
		.@r$ = callsub(L_SkillLearn, atoi(.@arg$), atoi(.@atcmd_parameters$[3]));
		if (.@r$ != "") {
			.@status$ = "err";
			.@msg$ = .@r$;
		}
		callsub L_Apply;
	} else if (.@cmd$ == "choose") {
		.@r$ = callsub(L_Choose, atoi(.@arg$), atoi(.@atcmd_parameters$[3]));
		if (.@r$ != "") {
			.@status$ = "err";
			.@msg$ = .@r$;
		}
		callsub L_Apply;
	}
	if (.@status$ != "ok")
		debugmes "[path-of-ragnarok] refused: " + .@msg$;
	callsub L_Reply, .@atcmd_parameters$[0], .@status$, .@msg$, (.@cmd$ == "cards");
	end;

// ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------
// Works out the start node and the points the character has earned.
L_Sync:
	.@eac = eaclass();
	.@base = .@eac & EAJ_BASEMASK;
	.@tier1 = ((.@eac & EAJ_UPPERMASK) == .@base);
	.@start = 0;
	if (.@eac >= 0) {
		switch (.@base) {
		case EAJ_SWORDMAN:	.@start = 1; break;
		case EAJ_ACOLYTE:	.@start = 2; break;
		case EAJ_MAGE:	.@start = 3; break;
		case EAJ_ARCHER:	.@start = 4; break;
		case EAJ_THIEF:	.@start = 5; break;
		case EAJ_MERCHANT:	.@start = 6; break;
		case EAJ_GUNSLINGER:	.@start = 4; break;
		case EAJ_NINJA:	.@start = 3; break;
		case EAJ_TAEKWON:
		case EAJ_SUMMONER:
		case EAJ_GANGSI:	.@start = 7; break;
		case EAJ_NOVICE:
			if (Class == Job_SuperNovice || Class == 4045 || Class == 4190) {
				.@start = 7;
				.@tier1 = 1;
			}
			break;
		}
	}
	if (.@start) {
		if (.@tier1)
			.@e = JobLevel * .ppl;
		else
			.@e = .max;
		.@e = min(.@e, .max);
		if (.@e > PT_earned)
			PT_earned = .@e;
		if (PT_start != .@start) {
			PT_start = .@start;
			deletearray PT_nodes[0], getarraysize(PT_nodes);
		}
	}
	// a socket that no longer exists (removed from the tree): give its card back
	.@s = getarraysize(PT_sn);
	for (.@i = .@s - 1; .@i >= 0; .@i--) {
		if (!.sock[PT_sn[.@i]]) {
			getitem PT_sc[.@i], 1;
			deletearray PT_sn[.@i], 1;
			deletearray PT_sc[.@i], 1;
		}
	}
	if (.@start && PT_ver != .ver) {
		callsub L_Migrate;
		PT_ver = .ver;
	}
	if (PT_start) {
		bonus_script "{ callfunc(\"F_PT_Bonus\"); }", 2000000;
		callsub L_Skills;
		callsub L_Falcon;
		recalculatestat;
	}
	return;

// The tree changed shape (.ver): refund everything for free so no allocation is left dangling. Cards go back to the inventory
// (getitem drops them next to the character when it is too heavy).
L_Migrate:
	.@s = getarraysize(PT_sc);
	.@had = getarraysize(PT_nodes) + .@s;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@s; .@i++)
		getitem PT_sc[.@i], 1;
	deletearray PT_sn[0], .@s;
	deletearray PT_sc[0], .@s;
	deletearray PT_nodes[0], getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	deletearray PT_mn[0], getarraysize(PT_mn);
	deletearray PT_mv[0], getarraysize(PT_mv);
	if (.@had)
		dispbottom "[Passive Tree] The tree was rearranged: your passive points were refunded for free. Open it with Alt+P to spend them again.";
	return;

// After any change: teach or take back skills, recalculate.
L_Apply:
	callsub L_Skills;
	callsub L_Falcon;
	recalculatestat;
	return;

// A node flagged .fal gives a falcon (to any class). We only take
// the falcon back if we were the ones who gave it.
L_Falcon:
	.@want = 0;
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
		if (.fal[PT_nodes[.@i]])
			.@want = 1;
	}
	if (.@want) {
		if (!checkfalcon()) {
			setfalcon 1;
			PT_gfal = 1;
		}
	} else if (PT_gfal) {
		if (checkfalcon())
			setfalcon 0;
		PT_gfal = 0;
	}
	return;

// Skills: first take back the ones older versions of the tree taught from nodes (PT_gs[]; we only ever recorded a skill the
// character did not have), then make sure every skill learned with skill points is there at its level.
L_Skills:
	.@g = getarraysize(PT_gs);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@g; .@i++)
		skill PT_gs[.@i], 0, 3;
	deletearray PT_gs[0], .@g;
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_ls);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
		if (getskilllv(PT_ls[.@i]) < PT_ll[.@i])
			skill PT_ls[.@i], PT_ll[.@i], 3;
	}
	return;

// Collects the skill points. Only once per character.
L_SkillClaim:
	if (.sp < 1)
		return "Skill points are switched off.";
	if (PT_spc)
		return "You already collected your skill points.";
	PT_spc = .sp;
	return "";

// Learns skill getarg(0) up to level getarg(1) for one point per level. Returns "" or the reason it was refused.
L_SkillLearn:
	.@id = getarg(0);
	.@lv = getarg(1);
	if (.sp < 1)
		return "Skill points are switched off.";
	if (!PT_spc)
		return "Collect your skill points first.";
	.@max = $@PT_skok[.@id];
	if (.@max < 1)
		return "That skill cannot be learned here.";
	if (.@lv < 1 || .@lv > .@max)
		return "That level does not exist.";
	.@have = getskilllv(.@id);
	if (.@have >= .@lv)
		return "You already know that skill at level " + .@have + ".";
	.@cost = .@lv - .@have;
	.@left = PT_spc - PT_sps;
	if (.@left < .@cost)
		return "That needs " + .@cost + " skill point" + (.@cost > 1 ? "s" : "") + " and you have " + .@left + ".";
	.@at = -1;
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_ls);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
		if (PT_ls[.@i] == .@id)
			.@at = .@i;
	}
	if (.@at < 0) {
		.@at = .@n;
		PT_ls[.@at] = .@id;
	}
	PT_ll[.@at] = .@lv;
	PT_sps += .@cost;
	return "";

// Allocates one node. Returns "" or the reason it was refused.
L_Alloc:
	.@id = getarg(0);
	if (.@id < 1 || .@id > .N)
		return "Unknown node.";
	if (.@id == PT_start)
		return "That is your starting node.";
	if (.wand[.@id]) {
		if (PT_start != 7)
			return "The centre is only open to the Wanderer start.";
	}
	if (.req[.@id]) {
		if (.req[.@id] != callsub(L_Line))
			return "That branch is for the " + .reqn$[.@id] + " job line.";
		if (.requp[.@id]) {
			if (!callsub(L_Upper))
				return "That branch is for reborn characters (" + .reqn$[.@id] + ").";
		}
	}
	if (.rs[.@id]) {
		if (getskilllv(.rs[.@id] / 1000) < .rs[.@id] % 1000)
			return "You need " + .rsn$[.@id] + ".";
	}
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	if (.@n >= min(PT_earned, .max))
		return "No passive points left.";
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
		if (PT_nodes[.@i] == .@id)
			return "Already allocated.";
	}
	if (.key[.@id] && .maxkeys > 0) {
		.@kc = 0;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
			if (.key[PT_nodes[.@i]])
				.@kc++;
		}
		if (.@kc >= .maxkeys)
			return "You can take at most " + .maxkeys + " keystone" + (.maxkeys > 1 ? "s" : "") + ". Refund one first.";
	}
	.@ok = 0;
	deletearray .@a$[0], getarraysize(.@a$);
	explode(.@a$, .adj$[.@id], ",");
	.@c = getarraysize(.@a$);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@c; .@i++) {
		.@x = atoi(.@a$[.@i]);
		if (.@x == PT_start)
			.@ok = 1;
		for (.@k = 0; .@k < .@n; .@k++) {
			if (PT_nodes[.@k] == .@x)
				.@ok = 1;
		}
	}
	if (!.@ok)
		return "Not connected to your tree.";
	PT_nodes[.@n] = .@id;
	return "";

// Takes one node back if everything else stays connected to the start. Costs zeny.
L_Refund:
	.@id = getarg(0);
	if (!.canrefund)
		return "Refunds are switched off.";
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	.@at = -1;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
		if (PT_nodes[.@i] == .@id)
			.@at = .@i;
		else
			.@in[PT_nodes[.@i]] = 1;
	}
	if (.@at < 0)
		return "That node is not allocated.";
	.@seen[PT_start] = 1;
	.@q[0] = PT_start;
	.@qh = 0;
	.@qt = 1;
	while (.@qh < .@qt) {
		.@cur = .@q[.@qh];
		.@qh++;
		deletearray .@a$[0], getarraysize(.@a$);
		explode(.@a$, .adj$[.@cur], ",");
		.@c = getarraysize(.@a$);
		for (.@k = 0; .@k < .@c; .@k++) {
			.@x = atoi(.@a$[.@k]);
			if (.@in[.@x] && !.@seen[.@x]) {
				.@seen[.@x] = 1;
				.@q[.@qt] = .@x;
				.@qt++;
			}
		}
	}
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
		if (PT_nodes[.@i] != .@id && !.@seen[PT_nodes[.@i]])
			return "Other nodes depend on this one.";
	}
	.@si = callsub(L_SocketIndex, .@id);
	if (.@si >= 0) {
		if (!checkweight(PT_sc[.@si], 1))
			return "You cannot carry the card from that socket right now.";
	}
	if (Zeny < .refund)
		return "You need " + .refund + " zeny.";
	Zeny -= .refund;
	if (.@si >= 0) {
		getitem PT_sc[.@si], 1;
		deletearray PT_sn[.@si], 1;
		deletearray PT_sc[.@si], 1;
	}
	.@mm = getarraysize(PT_mn);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@mm; .@i++) {
		if (PT_mn[.@i] == .@id) {
			deletearray PT_mn[.@i], 1;
			deletearray PT_mv[.@i], 1;
			break;
		}
	}
	deletearray PT_nodes[.@at], 1;
	return "";

// Takes every node back. Costs the refund price once per node.
L_Reset:
	if (!.canrefund)
		return "Refunds are switched off.";
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	if (.@n < 1)
		return "";
	.@cost = .refund * .@n;
	if (Zeny < .@cost)
		return "You need " + .@cost + " zeny.";
	.@s = getarraysize(PT_sc);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@s; .@i++) {
		if (!checkweight(PT_sc[.@i], 1))
			return "You cannot carry all the socketed cards back right now.";
	}
	Zeny -= .@cost;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@s; .@i++)
		getitem PT_sc[.@i], 1;
	deletearray PT_sn[0], .@s;
	deletearray PT_sc[0], .@s;
	deletearray PT_nodes[0], .@n;
	deletearray PT_mn[0], getarraysize(PT_mn);
	deletearray PT_mv[0], getarraysize(PT_mv);
	return "";

// Index of the socket node getarg(0) in PT_sn[], or -1.
L_SocketIndex:
	.@s = getarraysize(PT_sn);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@s; .@i++) {
		if (PT_sn[.@i] == getarg(0))
			return .@i;
	}
	return -1;

// Puts card getarg(1) from the inventory into socket node getarg(0). Returns "" or the reason it was refused.
L_Socket:
	.@node = getarg(0);
	.@card = getarg(1);
	if (!.cards)
		return "Card sockets are switched off.";
	if (!.sock[.@node])
		return "That node is not a card socket.";
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	.@has = 0;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
		if (PT_nodes[.@i] == .@node)
			.@has = 1;
	}
	if (!.@has)
		return "Allocate the socket first.";
	if ($@PT_cardok[.@card] != 1 && !($@PT_cardok[.@card] == 2 && .mvpcards))
		return "That card cannot go into a socket.";
	if (countitem(.@card) < 1)
		return "You do not have that card.";
	.@s = getarraysize(PT_sc);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@s; .@i++) {
		if (PT_sc[.@i] == .@card)
			return "That card is already in a socket.";
	}
	.@si = callsub(L_SocketIndex, .@node);
	if (.@si >= 0) {
		if (!checkweight(PT_sc[.@si], 1))
			return "You cannot carry the card you would swap out.";
	}
	if (Zeny < .sockzeny)
		return "You need " + .sockzeny + " zeny.";
	Zeny -= .sockzeny;
	delitem .@card, 1;
	if (.@si >= 0) {
		getitem PT_sc[.@si], 1;
		PT_sc[.@si] = .@card;
	} else {
		PT_sn[.@s] = .@node;
		PT_sc[.@s] = .@card;
	}
	return "";

// Takes the card out of socket node getarg(0) and back into the inventory.
L_Unsocket:
	.@si = callsub(L_SocketIndex, getarg(0));
	if (.@si < 0)
		return "That socket is empty.";
	if (!checkweight(PT_sc[.@si], 1))
		return "You cannot carry that card right now.";
	getitem PT_sc[.@si], 1;
	deletearray PT_sn[.@si], 1;
	deletearray PT_sc[.@si], 1;
	return "";

// The character's second-class line as a number (base class | 0x100 or 0x200), 0 for first classes and novices.
L_Line:
	.@e = eaclass();
	if (.@e < 0)
		return 0;
	return .@e & (EAJ_BASEMASK | EAJL_2);

// 1 for rebirth (High / transcended) classes.
L_Upper:
	.@e = eaclass();
	if (.@e < 0)
		return 0;
	return ((.@e & EAJL_UPPER) != 0);

// Picks option getarg(1) (1..4) of mastery node getarg(0).
L_Choose:
	.@node = getarg(0);
	.@opt = getarg(1);
	if (!.mast[.@node])
		return "That node has no choices.";
	if (.@opt < 1 || .@opt > .mast[.@node])
		return "Unknown choice.";
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	.@has = 0;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++) {
		if (PT_nodes[.@i] == .@node)
			.@has = 1;
	}
	if (!.@has)
		return "Allocate the node first.";
	.@m = getarraysize(PT_mn);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@m; .@i++) {
		if (PT_mn[.@i] == .@node) {
			PT_mv[.@i] = .@opt;
			return "";
		}
	}
	PT_mn[.@m] = .@node;
	PT_mv[.@m] = .@opt;
	return "";

// ---- saved builds (up to 5 slots per character) --------------------------------
// A slot keeps a copy of the tree (nodes, mastery choices, socketed card ids) in permanent character variables named
// PT_b<slot>_...: _used, _name$, _start, _ver, _nc/_n[] (nodes), _mc/_mn[]/_mv[] (masteries), _cc/_sn[]/_sc[] (cards).
// Loading replays the nodes through L_Alloc, so every rule (connection, job line, keystone limit, points) is checked again.

// Writes the current tree into slot getarg(0) under the name getarg(1).
L_BuildSave:
	.@s = getarg(0);
	.@p$ = "PT_b" + .@s + "_";
	callsub L_BuildClear, .@s;
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++)
		setd(.@p$ + "n[" + .@i + "]", PT_nodes[.@i]);
	setd(.@p$ + "nc", .@n);
	.@m = getarraysize(PT_mn);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@m; .@i++) {
		setd(.@p$ + "mn[" + .@i + "]", PT_mn[.@i]);
		setd(.@p$ + "mv[" + .@i + "]", PT_mv[.@i]);
	}
	setd(.@p$ + "mc", .@m);
	.@c = getarraysize(PT_sc);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@c; .@i++) {
		setd(.@p$ + "sn[" + .@i + "]", PT_sn[.@i]);
		setd(.@p$ + "sc[" + .@i + "]", PT_sc[.@i]);
	}
	setd(.@p$ + "cc", .@c);
	setd(.@p$ + "name$", getarg(1));
	setd(.@p$ + "start", PT_start);
	setd(.@p$ + "ver", .ver);
	setd(.@p$ + "used", 1);
	PT_slot = .@s;
	return;

// Empties slot getarg(0).
L_BuildClear:
	.@p$ = "PT_b" + getarg(0) + "_";
	.@n = getd(.@p$ + "nc");
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++)
		setd(.@p$ + "n[" + .@i + "]", 0);
	.@m = getd(.@p$ + "mc");
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@m; .@i++) {
		setd(.@p$ + "mn[" + .@i + "]", 0);
		setd(.@p$ + "mv[" + .@i + "]", 0);
	}
	.@c = getd(.@p$ + "cc");
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@c; .@i++) {
		setd(.@p$ + "sn[" + .@i + "]", 0);
		setd(.@p$ + "sc[" + .@i + "]", 0);
	}
	setd(.@p$ + "nc", 0);
	setd(.@p$ + "mc", 0);
	setd(.@p$ + "cc", 0);
	setd(.@p$ + "name$", "");
	setd(.@p$ + "start", 0);
	setd(.@p$ + "ver", 0);
	setd(.@p$ + "used", 0);
	if (PT_slot == getarg(0))
		PT_slot = 0;
	return;

// Swaps the current tree for slot getarg(0). Sets @pt_bok to 1 when it worked; returns the message.
L_BuildLoad:
	.@s = getarg(0);
	.@p$ = "PT_b" + .@s + "_";
	@pt_bok = 0;
	if (.@s < 1 || .@s > .builds)
		return "Unknown slot.";
	if (!getd(.@p$ + "used"))
		return "That slot is empty.";
	if (getd(.@p$ + "ver") != .ver)
		return "That build was saved with an older version of the tree and cannot be loaded.";
	if (getd(.@p$ + "start") != PT_start)
		return "That build belongs to another starting class.";
	if (Zeny < .swapzeny)
		return "You need " + .swapzeny + " zeny.";
	.@c = getarraysize(PT_sc);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@c; .@i++) {
		if (!checkweight(PT_sc[.@i], 1))
			return "You cannot carry the socketed cards back right now.";
	}
	Zeny -= .swapzeny;
	// put the current tree away: cards back to the inventory, everything cleared
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@c; .@i++)
		getitem PT_sc[.@i], 1;
	deletearray PT_sn[0], .@c;
	deletearray PT_sc[0], .@c;
	deletearray PT_nodes[0], getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	deletearray PT_mn[0], getarraysize(PT_mn);
	deletearray PT_mv[0], getarraysize(PT_mv);
	// replay the nodes: repeat until a whole pass allocates nothing (a node can be saved before the one it hangs off)
	.@nc = getd(.@p$ + "nc");
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@nc; .@i++) {
		.@want[.@i] = getd(.@p$ + "n[" + .@i + "]");
		.@done[.@i] = 0;
	}
	.@left = .@nc;
	.@progress = 1;
	while (.@progress && .@left > 0) {
		.@progress = 0;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@nc; .@i++) {
			if (.@done[.@i])
				continue;
			.@r$ = callsub(L_Alloc, .@want[.@i]);
			if (.@r$ == "") {
				.@done[.@i] = 1;
				.@left--;
				.@progress = 1;
			}
		}
	}
	.@mc = getd(.@p$ + "mc");
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@mc; .@i++)
		callsub L_Choose, getd(.@p$ + "mn[" + .@i + "]"), getd(.@p$ + "mv[" + .@i + "]");
	.@cc = getd(.@p$ + "cc");
	.@missing = 0;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@cc; .@i++) {
		.@r$ = callsub(L_Socket, getd(.@p$ + "sn[" + .@i + "]"), getd(.@p$ + "sc[" + .@i + "]"));
		if (.@r$ != "")
			.@missing++;
	}
	PT_slot = .@s;
	@pt_bok = 1;
	.@msg$ = "Loaded " + getd(.@p$ + "name$") + ": " + (.@nc - .@left) + " of " + .@nc + " nodes.";
	if (.@left)
		.@msg$ += " " + .@left + " could not be taken (points, job line or keystone limit).";
	if (.@missing)
		.@msg$ += " " + .@missing + " card" + (.@missing > 1 ? "s" : "") + " not socketed (not in your inventory).";
	return .@msg$;

// Cleans a build name: letters, digits, - and _ only, at most 16 characters. Returns "" when nothing usable is left.
L_BuildName:
	.@in$ = getarg(0);
	.@out$ = "";
	.@allowed$ = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-";
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < getstrlen(.@in$) && .@i < 16; .@i++) {
		if (strpos(.@allowed$, charat(.@in$, .@i)) != -1)
			.@out$ += charat(.@in$, .@i);
	}
	return .@out$;

// One @@reply line (split into parts when long):
// status|message|start|points|mult|refund|ids|sockets|inventory cards|cards on|socket price|choices|job line|...|learned
// getarg(3) = 1 adds the cards in the inventory that can be socketed.
L_Reply:
	.@ids$ = "";
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@n; .@i++)
		.@ids$ += (.@i ? "," : "") + PT_nodes[.@i];
	.@sock$ = "";
	.@s = getarraysize(PT_sn);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@s; .@i++)
		.@sock$ += (.@i ? "," : "") + PT_sn[.@i] + ":" + PT_sc[.@i];
	.@inv$ = "";
	if (getarg(3) && .cards) {
		getinventorylist;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < @inventorylist_count; .@i++) {
			.@c = @inventorylist_id[.@i];
			if ($@PT_cardok[.@c] != 1 && !($@PT_cardok[.@c] == 2 && .mvpcards))
				continue;
			.@dup = 0;
			for (.@k = 0; .@k < .@s; .@k++) {
				if (PT_sc[.@k] == .@c)
					.@dup = 1;
			}
			if (!.@dup)
				.@inv$ += (.@inv$ != "" ? "," : "") + .@c + ":" + @inventorylist_amount[.@i];
		}
	}
	.@bs$ = "";
	for (.@b = 1; .@b <= .builds; .@b++) {
		.@bp$ = "PT_b" + .@b + "_";
		if (.@b > 1)
			.@bs$ += ",";
		if (getd(.@bp$ + "used"))
			.@bs$ += getd(.@bp$ + "name$") + ":" + getd(.@bp$ + "nc") + ":" + (getd(.@bp$ + "ver") == .ver ? 1 : 0);
		else
			.@bs$ += "-";
	}
	.@choice$ = "";
	.@mm = getarraysize(PT_mn);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@mm; .@i++)
		.@choice$ += (.@i ? "," : "") + PT_mn[.@i] + ":" + PT_mv[.@i];
	.@learned$ = "";
	.@ls = getarraysize(PT_ls);
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@ls; .@i++)
		.@learned$ += (.@i ? "," : "") + PT_ls[.@i] + ":" + PT_ll[.@i];
	.@m = $@PT_mult;
	if (.@m < 10)
		.@m = 100;
	.@r = .canrefund ? .refund : -1;
	.@out$ = getarg(1) + "|" + getarg(2) + "|" + PT_start + "|" + min(PT_earned, .max) + "|" + .@m + "|" + .@r + "|" + .@ids$ + "|" + .@sock$ + "|" + .@inv$ + "|" + .cards + "|" + .sockzeny + "|" + .@choice$ + "|" + callsub(L_Line) + "|" + .maxkeys + "|" + callsub(L_Upper) + "|" + $@PT_dropcap + "|" + .@bs$ + "|" + PT_slot + "|" + .swapzeny + "|" + .sp + "|" + PT_spc + "|" + PT_sps + "|" + $@PT_re + "|" + .@learned$;
	.@len = getstrlen(.@out$);
	.@parts = (.@len + 149) / 150;
	for (.@p = 0; .@p < .@parts; .@p++)
		dispbottom "@@reply " + getarg(0) + " " + (.@p + 1) + "/" + .@parts + " " + substr(.@out$, .@p * 150, min(.@len, (.@p + 1) * 150) - 1);
	return;
}

// Run by the permanent bonus_script on every stat recalculation.
function	script	F_PT_Bonus	{
	freeloop(1);
	.@m = $@PT_mult;
	if (.@m < 10)
		.@m = 100;
	.@n = getarraysize(PT_nodes);
	// what the equipped gear allows (auto-cast nodes only apply for skills usable with it)
	.@wid = getequipid(EQI_HAND_R);
	if (.@wid > 0)
		.@w = getiteminfo(.@wid, ITEMINFO_SUBTYPE);
	else
		.@w = W_FIST;
	.@shield = 0;
	.@lid = getequipid(EQI_HAND_L);
	if (.@lid > 0) {
		if (getiteminfo(.@lid, ITEMINFO_TYPE) == IT_ARMOR)
			.@shield = 1;
	}
	.@drop = 0;
	.@mm = getarraysize(PT_mn);
	for (.@i = -1; .@i < .@n + .@mm; .@i++) {
		if (.@i < 0)
			.@id = PT_start;
		else if (.@i < .@n)
			.@id = PT_nodes[.@i];
		else
			.@id = PT_mn[.@i - .@n] * 10 + PT_mv[.@i - .@n];
		if (.@id <= 366) {
			if (.@id <= 179) {
				if (.@id <= 89) {
					if (.@id <= 44) {
						if (.@id <= 22) {
							if (.@id <= 11) {
								if (.@id <= 5) {
									if (.@id <= 2) {
										if (.@id == 1) {	// Swordsman's Origin
											bonus bStr,max(1,(.@m*2+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 2) {	// Acolyte's Origin
											bonus bVit,max(1,(.@m*2+50)/100);
										}
									} else {
										if (.@id == 3) {	// Mage's Origin
											bonus bInt,max(1,(.@m*2+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4) {	// Archer's Origin
											bonus bDex,max(1,(.@m*2+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 5) {	// Thief's Origin
											bonus bAgi,max(1,(.@m*2+50)/100);
										}
									}
								} else {

											bonus bStr,max(1,(.@m*3+50)/100);
											bonus bAtk,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 11) {	// Max HP
											bonus bMaxHPrate,max(1,(.@m*1+50)/100);
										}
									}
								}
							} else {
								if (.@id <= 16) {
									if (.@id <= 13) {
										if (.@id == 12) {	// Strength
											bonus bStr,max(1,(.@m*1+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 13) {	// Max HP

										}

											bonus bSPrecovRate,max(1,(.@m*3+50)/100);
										}
									}
								} else {
									if (.@id <= 74) {
										if (.@id == 72) {	// Arcane Studies
											bonus bInt,max(1,(.@m*3+50)/100);
											bonus bMatk,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 73) {	// SP Cost
											bonus bUseSPrate,min(-1,(.@m*(-1)-50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 74) {	// Intelligence
											bonus bInt,max(1,(.@m*1+50)/100);
										}
									} else {
										if (.@id == 75) {	// Max SP
											bonus bMaxSP,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 76) {	// Magic Attack
											bonus bMatkRate,max(1,(.@m*1+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 77) {	// Magic Attack
											bonus bMatk,max(1,(.@m*3+50)/100);
										}
									}
								}
							} else {
								if (.@id <= 83) {
									if (.@id <= 80) {
										if (.@id == 78) {	// Mana Well
											bonus bMaxSP,max(1,(.@m*40+50)/100);
											bonus bSPrecovRate,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 79) {	// SP Recovery
											bonus bSPrecovRate,max(1,(.@m*3+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 80) {	// Cast Time
											bonus bCastrate,min(-1,(.@m*(-1)-50)/100);
										}
									} else {
										if (.@id == 81) {	// Max SP
											bonus bMaxSPrate,max(1,(.@m*1+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 82) {	// Magic Attack

											bonus bMatkRate,max(1,(.@m*5+50)/100);
										}
									} else {
										if (.@id == 4121) {	// Hunting Doctrine: Beasts
											bonus2 bAddRace,RC_Brute,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4122) {	// Hunting Doctrine: Insects
											bonus2 bAddRace,RC_Insect,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4123) {	// Hunting Doctrine: Plants
											bonus2 bAddRace,RC_Plant,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
										}
									}
								} else {
									if (.@id <= 4182) {
										if (.@id == 4124) {	// Hunting Doctrine: Fish and Dragons
											bonus2 bAddRace,RC_Fish,max(1,(.@m*6+50)/100);
											bonus2 bAddRace,RC_Dragon,max(1,(.@m*6+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4181) {	// Marksman Doctrine: Reach
											bonus bLongAtkRate,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4182) {	// Marksman Doctrine: Precision
											bonus bCritical,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
											bonus bHit,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
										}
									} else {
										if (.@id == 4183) {	// Marksman Doctrine: Tempo
											bonus bAspdRate,max(1,(.@m*4+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4291) {	// Venom Doctrine: Poison
											bonus2 bAddEff,Eff_Poison,max(1,(.@m*800+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4292) {	// Venom Doctrine: Bleeding
											bonus2 bAddEff,Eff_Bleeding,max(1,(.@m*800+50)/100);
										}
									}
								}
							} else {
								if (.@id <= 4461) {
									if (.@id <= 4351) {
										if (.@id == 4293) {	// Venom Doctrine: Blindness
											bonus2 bAddEff,Eff_Blind,max(1,(.@m*800+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4294) {	// Venom Doctrine: Stun
											bonus2 bAddEff,Eff_Stun,max(1,(.@m*600+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4351) {	// Shadow Doctrine: Evasion
											bonus bFlee,max(1,(.@m*12+50)/100);
										}
									} else {
										if (.@id == 4352) {	// Shadow Doctrine: Perfect Dodge
											bonus bFlee2,max(1,(.@m*50+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4353) {	// Shadow Doctrine: Haste
											bonus bSpeedAddRate,max(1,(.@m*8+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4461) {	// Trade Doctrine: Experience
											bonus2 bExpAddRace,RC_All,max(1,(.@m*6+50)/100);
										}
									}
								} else {
									if (.@id <= 4464) {
										if (.@id == 4462) {	// Trade Doctrine: Plunder
											.@drop += max(1,(.@m*5+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4463) {	// Trade Doctrine: Cargo
											bonus bAddMaxWeight,max(1,(.@m*5000+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4464) {	// Trade Doctrine: Gold
											bonus2 bGetZenyNum,1000,max(1,(.@m*12+50)/100);
										}
									} else {
										if (.@id == 4521) {	// Craft Doctrine: Medicine
											bonus bAddItemHealRate,max(1,(.@m*15+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4522) {	// Craft Doctrine: Pilfering
											bonus bAddStealRate,max(1,(.@m*1000+50)/100);
										} else if (.@id == 4523) {	// Craft Doctrine: Fortune
											bonus bLuk,max(1,(.@m*4+50)/100);
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	// item drop rate: the nodes add up in hundredths of a percent (0.1% per small node); rAthena only takes whole percents, so the
	// total is capped, then rounded down
	.@dropp = min(.@drop, $@PT_dropcap * 100) / 100;
	if (.@dropp > 0)
		bonus2 bDropAddRace, RC_All, .@dropp;
	if ($@PT_cards) {
		.@s = getarraysize(PT_sc);
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@s; .@i++) {
			if ($@PT_cardok[PT_sc[.@i]] == 1 || ($@PT_cardok[PT_sc[.@i]] == 2 && $@PT_mvpcards))
				callfunc("F_PT_Card", PT_sc[.@i]);
		}
	}
	return;
}
